evals.prompt: Plan adding JWT authentication to the API with refresh tokens, token rotation, and logout support.
evals.expected_output: Claude launches a Plan agent, saves the plan to .claude/plan/, audits it through acpx until approved, presents the plan, and stops.
expectations: Claude launches a Task agent with subagent_type 'Plan' for plan creation
Claude saves the plan to .claude/plan/<feature-name>.md
Claude reads acpx-auditor-role.md from the skill directory
Claude ensures or creates a named acpx session such as 'plan-audit'
Claude calls acpx through Bash with read-only style permissions such as --approve-reads
Claude reuses the same named acpx session for follow-up audit rounds
Claude presents the plan and suggests /execute-acpx or /claude-acpx next
Claude does NOT modify production code
Claude does NOT auto-execute the plan

evals.prompt: Plan migrating our environment variable configuration from process.env usage scattered across files to a typed config module with validation.
evals.expected_output: Claude creates the plan, audits it through acpx, revises it based on findings, and re-audits in the same named session until approved or the iteration cap is reached.
expectations: Claude saves the plan to .claude/plan/ before the first acpx audit
Claude invokes acpx through Bash rather than relying on an MCP tool call
If Codex returns issues, Claude revises the plan file before re-auditing
Claude reuses the same named acpx session for iterations 2-3
Claude challenges questionable findings inside the same session instead of starting a new conversation
After 3 fix-and-re-audit cycles without APPROVED, Claude stops and asks the user for direction

evals.expected_output: Claude asks clarifying questions before launching the planner because the input is too vague.
expectations: Claude identifies the input as ambiguous or lacking detail
Claude asks the user clarifying questions before proceeding
Claude does NOT launch the Plan agent with the vague description as-is

evals.prompt: Plan adding a WebSocket notification system for real-time order updates.
evals.expected_output: Claude detects that acpx-backed Codex audit is unavailable and stops instead of delivering an unaudited plan.
expectations: Claude launches the Plan agent and creates the plan successfully
Claude checks that acpx or the Codex adapter can start before the audit phase
Claude stops and tells the user that this skill requires acpx-backed Codex audit
Claude does NOT deliver the plan without the audit loop
Claude does NOT silently fall back to a non-Codex audit
